messages.content: How do creators usually handle taxes on this kind of income?

This varies a lot by country and local law, so I can't give you specific numbers, but the general principle is that this income is typically taxable and needs to be tracked like any self-employment income. Do you know if your country treats it as self-employment or something else?
Not sure honestly, never looked into it properly.

That's worth sorting out early rather than later — a local accountant or tax advisor familiar with online income is genuinely worth the cost here, since getting it wrong can create bigger problems down the line than the consultation fee.
